notes: OATS CAMS: a camera-only menu-bar app (house icon) next to VJ VIZZIES in the dmg, and as its own small dmg. It installs and starts only the hub and the cameras, owns the camera permission, has its own login item and menu (per-camera status, Restart cameras, Restart hub, hub page, multiview). With both installed, VJ VIZZIES leaves the cameras to OATS CAMS.
